scope: Metadata-only final assessment of C1 failure attribution, C2 value, adoption, and completed downstream measurements

main_c1.click_timeout_overlap: The 15 click-timeout page records are also HTTP 200 page records; they are not an additional disjoint failure count.
main_c1.selection_attribution_reason: The scored records contain visited pages and outcomes, but not the full candidate set available at each decision. A valid-HTML target-selection error cannot be identified or counted from these metadata alone. The 3 reached unique targets do not make the other 85 targets selection failures.
main_c1.saved_path_link_missing_note: No saved_path_link_missing category appears in current C1 scored metadata; do not infer B1 counts for C1.

access_and_environment.attribution: 503 is an environment/upstream transport failure in this run's evidence and is not classified as a site block or C1 selection failure. Access-condition skips are separate from executed failures.

public_challenges.completed_failure_detail: All 8 completed rows ended content_unchanged, with no recorded navigation errors.
public_challenges.c2_relevance: No challenge failure is evidence of candidate-ranking failure; completed rows show unchanged content, and access skips did not exercise the method.

c2_recommendation.decision: Skip C2 for this experiment. Do not claim numeric model value.
c2_recommendation.why: Observed failures are dominated by transport 503, UI/navigation errors, access conditions, and missing evidence. The available scored metadata does not preserve all alternatives at each decision, so actual selection errors remain unknown. A model cannot be credited for fixing transport or UI execution.
c2_recommendation.reconsideration_condition: Reconsider only if a later offline audit of frozen candidate sets establishes that viable candidates were available and C1 selected poorly.

integration_and_adoption.final_adoption: Do not adopt C1 as a production Skill: volume and G/R benefit are not established, and the observed run is not a full healthy-environment comparison. Separate infrastructure failures from algorithm performance.
integration_and_adoption.minimal_skill_proposal: The source Skill's parser_flow is a static AST-derived hint for representative paths. A minimal integration can pass its start/candidate/transition hints to a non-LLM, budgeted runner and retain frozen graph/rules/path provenance, raw HTML/DOM, state and cost records, and independent G/R scoring. This is a proposal, not measured production performance.
integration_and_adoption.candidate_audit: Reuse the existing candidate-audit for revision, dependency, licensing/distribution, and install checks. Candidate-audit is not a product-performance score and must not be presented as one.
integration_and_adoption.b2_recommendation: Conditional only; do not reject B2 as universally unsuccessful because primary C1 did reach 3 unique targets. Compare B2 only under a healthy, adequately covered evaluation.

limitations: Metadata only; no HTML, DOM, live network, or primary result changes were used.
The 113 eligible page records are page observations, not 113 independent candidates or 113 selection failures.
Challenge result counts exclude 20 accidental preflight rows.
All 80 sites have operational records, but upstream 503/access/incomplete conditions mean this is not a full healthy-environment comparison.
B0 produced 84 page records with HTTP 503; 33 site rows had no valid manifest target and 2 stopped at access conditions.
Stage C froze 100 targets for each of two sites but reached zero independent targets; 10/30/100 milestone costs remain null, not zero.
Connectivity checks (robots 404 and successful Git) coexist with browser target-page 503 responses; they do not establish healthy target-page access.

main_comparison.completion_interpretation: All 80 sites have operational records, but this is not a full healthy-environment comparison; B1/C1 include upstream 503, access conditions, and incomplete trials.

b0.interpretation: B0 ran where fixed manifest URLs were available; observed page records were 503. B0 does not establish a healthy-environment comparison.

recovery.interpretation: All 12 records completed; 4 page records were 503. Not evidence of healthy target-page access.

stage_c.interpretation: 100 targets per site were frozen, but not reached. Milestone costs remain null because milestones were unmet; they are not zero.

transport_diagnostic.interpretation: Connectivity was partly restored, but browser requests to target pages still returned 503. This does not show site-side blocking or a healthy page-comparison environment.
